sentences.Emma må ha nye sko, og jeg må gjøre ferd: Emma needs new shoes, and I have to finish a report for tomorrow.
sentences.Kan du bli med henne i butikken?: Can you go to the shop with her?
sentences.Nei, nå vil jeg lese avisen og slappe av: No, now I want to read the newspaper and relax.
sentences.Det var mange kjedelige møter på skolen: There were lots of boring meetings at school today.
The shoe shop is open until six o'clock.
She needs new shoes today, Henrik.
She's going to a birthday party tomorrow.
sentences.Jeg skal gjøre det, men du maser for mye: I'll do it, but you nag too much.
sentences.Og så må du kjøpe toalettpapir, brød, en: And then you have to buy toilet paper, bread, a cucumber and some broccoli.
sentences.Emma må ha nye sko, men Henrik har ikke: Emma needs new shoes, but Henrik doesn't want to go to the shop with her.
sentences.Det var mye å gjøre på jobben, og nå er: There was a lot to do at work, and now he's worn out and wants to read the newspaper.
sentences.Marianne blir irritert, og til slutt må: Marianne gets annoyed, and in the end Henrik has to go to the shop.
